items.title: Beyond Vector Search: Graph-Augmented RAG with PostgreSQL SQL/PGQ
items.summary: Presented at PGConf.Asia 2026, Hong Kong, November 17, 2026.https://pgconf.asia/EN/2026/Vector search is a useful starting point for RAG, but enterprise knowledge is more than text. Relationships between people, companies, events, and documents provide important context that vector similarity alone cannot capture.This talk explores how PostgreSQL can combine pgvector, SQL, and SQL/PGQ to support Graph-Augmented RAG. Using a practical example, it shows how vector search finds relevant documents while graph queries connect them to entities, relationships, and supporting evidence.The session also introduces the SQL/PGQ and GQL standards and discusses ongoing SQL/PGQ development for PostgreSQL 20 and beyond.Key takeaway: Knowledge is more than text. Relationships give it context.
